init.title: Configure Imou Life
init.description: Choose which settings to change. Each section saves when you submit that form.

general_settings.title: Status polling and camera defaults
general_settings.description: How often Home Assistant refreshes device status.

data_description.enable_polling: Turn off to skip periodic cloud refreshes. Entity states may become outdated. Setup and reload still fetch the device list once.
data_description.update_interval: Default 300s (5 minutes), range 30–900s. Ignored when polling is off.

camera_defaults.name: Camera defaults
camera_defaults.description: Live stream and PTZ defaults for this account.

data_description.download_snap_wait_time: Seconds to wait before downloading a snapshot. Default 3s.
data_description.rotation_duration: How long a single PTZ button press moves. Default 500ms.

event_push.title: Alarm push, notifications, and local recording
event_push.description: Receive alarms in Home Assistant in real time. You can also notify your phone and save a short clip.

data_description.enable_event_push: Registers a callback with Imou cloud. Alarms also sync to the Imou Life app.

subscriptions.name: Message types
subscriptions.description: Which Imou cloud messages to receive when event push is on.

notifications.name: Notify on alarm
notifications.description: Optional. Leave empty to handle alarms only with automations.

data_description.notify_services: These are notify services already registered in this Home Assistant. Each alarm sends one message to the selected targets. To skip a device, turn off **Notify on alarm** on its device page.

local_recording.name: Local recording
local_recording.description: This page only sets the shared folder and clip length. On each camera device page, turn on **Record on alarm** (Configuration). Clips start after the alarm (no pre-roll) and use live-stream quota. The folder must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

data_description.local_record_path: Example: /media/imou. Leave empty to skip saving. The per-camera switch is on the device page, not here.
data_description.local_record_duration: Length of each post-alarm clip. Default 60s, range 15–180s.

callback.name: Callback URL
callback.description: Suggested: {suggested_url}. Imou cloud must reach this URL from the internet. If it is a LAN address, change the hostname and port as needed; keep the path.

data_description.webhook_url: Required when event push is on. Paste the suggested URL, or change the hostname and port if it is not public.

devices_menu.title: Choose and bind devices
devices_menu.description: Choose which devices to poll, or bind a new one to this account.

select_poll_devices.title: Choose devices to poll
select_poll_devices.description: Found {device_count} device(s). Unselected devices stay in Home Assistant but are not polled.

no_devices_menu.title: No devices found
no_devices_menu.description: This account has no Imou devices yet. Bind a device now, or save without binding.

devices_unavailable.title: Could not reach the Imou cloud
devices_unavailable.description:
The device list could not be fetched: {error}

You can try again, or save your other changes and leave the device selection as it is.

bind_device.title: Bind a new device
bind_device.description: Enter the device serial number and binding code from the Imou Life app or device label.

data_description.device_id: Serial number (SN) printed on the device or shown in the Imou Life app
data_description.code: Optional. Leave empty if the device does not require a binding code

options.alarm: Device alarms (smoke, gas, human, picture change, etc.)

stream_source_failed.message: Could not get the live stream URL from Imou: {error}

camera_image_failed.message: Could not get a snapshot from Imou: {error}

not_a_ptz_button.message: {entity_id} is not a PTZ button, so it cannot be moved. Target a PTZ direction button instead.

remove_device_missing_id.message: Cannot remove device {name}: missing Imou device id.

remove_device_has_siblings.message: Cannot remove {name}: it is one channel of Imou device {device_id}, which also covers {siblings}. Deselect the whole device in the integration options to stop polling it, or disable this channel's entities to hide it.

remove_device_no_runtime.message: Cannot remove device {name}: integration is not loaded.
